authority: Fictional customer reporting standards for this fixture only
precedence: Security/platform controls and confirmed facts cannot be overridden; customer mandatory rules override generic recommendations.

rules.text: Use SalesPerformance as the project name and Executive Summary / Regional Performance as the page names.
Use fictional theme Sales Demo: background #FFFFFF, text #172B4D, primary #005A9C. Do not convey meaning through colour alone.
Executive Summary must show Total Sales, distinct Total Orders, Average Order Value and Sales YoY %.
Use meaningful visual names and titles, readable labels, text alternatives and deliberate keyboard navigation. Actual accessibility verification remains pending.
Use the dedicated contiguous DimDate table for calendar-year comparisons; never fabricate missing prior-year values.
Prefer bar charts over pie/donut charts for regional and category comparisons.
Region is a filter, not access control. Do not claim RLS unless explicitly requested, implemented and runtime-tested.
Document local synthetic CSV inputs and unresolved deployment actions. Use TARGET_WORKSPACE_PLACEHOLDER rather than any real tenant, credential or endpoint.
